title: Merry Christmas to all who celebrate this day!
excerpt: Merry Christmas to all who celebrate this day! How was Wynona Lamborn's Christmas? Let's find out ... Dec. 25. Christmas morning. If all people could only have a Merry Xmas, how nice it would be, but, alas! how many do not have! I recd. ten
